title: Crates tied with ropes
story: Stacks of plastic crates held only by ropes, which Brazilian rules prohibit.
story_pt: Pilhas de caixas plásticas presas só com cordas, proibidas pelas regras brasileiras.

analysis.summary: A small flatbed truck carries tall stacks of empty plastic crates secured only with about six ropes over the top.

contran_945.message: Ropes are prohibited as cargo lashing; use straps or chains.
The lashings' working capacity is less than twice the weight they hold.
Each unit of split cargo needs at least 4 lashing terminals.
Lashings are anchored to the truck's lashing points on the metal frame.
The load does not fill the body length: close the gaps or add diagonal lashings against forward and backward movement.
The load stands taller than a 1.2 m headboard; confirm the headboard height.

changes.message: Ropes are prohibited as cargo lashing: replace them with ratchet straps.
Secure the load with direct instead of top over.
Put edge protectors under the straps where they cross the cartons or sacks.
